text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down slightly over the past day, with BTC showing marginally more weakness than ETH, while smaller caps like SOL and BNB have held up fractionally better. The Fear & Greed index sits at 31, indicating genuine fear sentiment that has intensified over the past week, suggesting market participants are risk-averse. Bitcoin's dominance near 57% coupled with $60B in daily volume reflects a cautious market where investors are rotating toward the largest, most liquid assets.
